text:
julia.p: Quick heads-up  VoxBill trial ends Thursday. Finance flagged seat-based vs usage-based lines and wants a clear mapping before procurement signs. Can someone surface the sanitized invoice?
mohit: Pulled the sample. They have three bill types: seats, API-usage (tokens), and feature-flags (per-feature monthly).
tara: Paste the sanitized invoice so procurement can map to our SKUs.
mohit: Snippet (sanitized):
```
VOXBILL SEAT-MONTH: 6 seats @ $120/seat = $720.00
VOXBILL API-TOKENS: 510,240 tokens @ $0.00085/token = $433.70
VOXBILL FEATURE-ALERTS: 1 flag @ $350/flag = $350.00
REGIONAL FX ADJUSTMENT (EUR): $14.30
TOTAL = $1,518.00
```
julia.p: Two immediate asks from procurement: 1) can they produce a CSV export with sku_id + counts_toward_commit boolean? 2) policy on multi-currency invoices and FX reconciliation?
tara: Also: are seats pro-rated mid-month when we add/remove users? Our payroll billing requires prorated line items.
olga (VoxBill): Hi all  happy to clarify. We can provide a CSV with sku_id, unit, qty, unit_price, currency, counts_toward_commit, invoice_line_id. Seats are pro-rated daily by default; we can switch to month-bucket proration if you prefer. We support EUR invoices and will include an fx_rate column on CSV and a separate fx_adjustment line.
mohit: Commit discounts? We usually prefer usage-only, but procurement may like a blended commit for predictability.
olga (VoxBill): We offer two contract models: pure usage at list, or blended commit (seat + usage credit). Example blended offer: $5k/month commit gives 18% off seat rates and $3k/month usage credit; unused usage credit rolls over for 90 days and then expires. Annual true-ups apply. Overage beyond credits is billed at list.
julia.p: Rollover expiry is important. Finance won't accept credits that vanish mid-year without clear accounting treatment. Can rollover be 12 months instead of 90 days?
olga (VoxBill): We can extend rollover to 12 months for a 24-month commitment. Otherwise 90 days for 12mo.
tara: Billing reconciliation: our ETL expects a stable invoice_line_id and a way to dedupe. Also want an API endpoint to pull per-usage events for ingestion.
olga (VoxBill): We'll include invoice_line_id (UUID), and provide a billing events API (NDJSON stream) with event types: usage, seat-change, credit-apply. We'll provide schema and example payloads.
julia.p: Tokenization: we've seen a 6% delta on tokens vs vendor counts historically. Will you sign a reconciliation addendum to accept our counts for billing if audit passes?
olga (VoxBill): VoxBill uses a hybrid tokenizer similar to BPE. We'll provide our script. We can sign an addendum to accept Redwood counts, subject to a 2-week initial audit and a short SLA for disputes (5 business days).
legal-bot: Reminder: vendor risk questionnaire pending (https://vendor-portal.redwood.com/risk/voxbill). Assigned to @tara and @legal.team. Due in 7 days.
mohit: Tax & VAT: will VoxBill reverse-charge for EU VAT IDs, and include VAT_ID on CSV? Also need to know whether their invoice shows gross vs net amounts per line.
olga (VoxBill): We support reverse-charge and include VAT_ID and tax_summary columns. We provide both gross and net columns per line to simplify accounting.
julia.p: One more ask: if we switch some customers to Dedicated (private deployment) later, will billing model change materially (e.g., charge for infra separately)? Need a clear migration pricing table.
olga (VoxBill): Dedicated is priced separately: base infra fee + per-seat/license. We'll provide a migration pricing appendix showing equivalence and one-time migration credits if you commit.
tara: Great. Next steps: @olga please upload CSV price sheet with sku_ids, example machine-readable invoice (CSV), tokenization script, and a draft reconciliation addendum. Also confirm proration behavior and rollover policy in writing. @tara/legal will do the vendor risk + SOC2 request. If we get the CSV today I can run a cost projection against last 90 days and post numbers before EOD tomorrow.
olga (VoxBill): Will upload CSV and addendum today and send a formal blended commit quote showing the 12mo and 24mo rollover options. Happy to join a 20m call if helpful.
julia.p: Thanks everyone. If reconciliation addendum is approved we can wire up ingestion and avoid manual fixes at renewal.
